title: Intake: inbound signals
summary: Takes events in: POST /hooks/intake/<source> on the console server (per-source secret as bearer token or HMAC-SHA256, 256 KB body cap, 300 s replay window, dedupe by key) and feed pollers, normalised into one Event shape in company/work/intake/events.jsonl.
enableWhen: the world must push events in, with no polling equivalent

tools.purpose: webhook verification, normalisation, dedupe, the events log and the feed pollers

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner

meters.why: every event the company took in, append-only
every refused webhook or over-limit event, append-only
